audit_method: static IR lane and native Linux x86-64 self-source evidence; no source reread by emitter
count_basis: Counts are emitted aggregate counters or explicit IR lane counts. A null count means the current IR does not distinguish that shape independently; no count is inferred from source text.

required_shapes.ir_representation: event opcode 1 plus aggregate ir_return_count; only the separate bootstrap ir_value/function return lane carries a literal subset value
ir_function_param_start and ir_function_param_count aggregates; no parameter identity, type, ABI slot, or value-definition lane
local_count and assignment event counts; no local identity, type, mutability, or frame-slot lane
not independently represented; event opcode 6/7 records assignment-category events without a source/result value relationship
not independently represented; 75 aggregate assignment events are present but destination/value IDs are absent
ir_value_records_0..3 contain packed value records, but not a typed definition/use table; ir_value is a separate literal-return bootstrap lane
event opcodes 8..11 and aggregate binop count; operand and result value IDs are not preserved per instruction
event opcodes 12..15 and aggregate comparison count; condition/result value IDs are not preserved per instruction
callee, start bank/slot, count, flags and three argument banks are preserved; result value and call instruction ordering/definition are not
same bounded call lanes with foreign flag and callee identity; host ABI argument/result lowering is not represented as an instruction shape
block terminator and target_a/target_b lanes are present; condition value ID and complete terminator semantics are absent
target lanes exist on bounded blocks, but no complete per-block instruction/terminator stream is serialized
loop aggregate and synthetic bounded target lanes; no condition value/use relationship for a real loop body
event opcode 5 and aggregate discard counter; side-effecting instruction identity is not linked to a call/store result
no cast event or cast value lane observed in the canonical self-source audit
